title: Family-Tree Growth Over Time
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familytree:node
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as added by _time
| eventstats sum(added) as total_people
| sort _time
description: Trends how many people you have added to your family tree each month and the running total.
value: Seeing steady growth keeps a long research project motivating and shows how far the tree has come.
implementation: Ingest tree additions into `index=personal`; trend monthly and cumulative counts.
visualization: Column chart of people added per month with a running total.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many relatives you add to your family tree each month, showing how it grows over time.
